rules.message: app/ must not import src/ internals directly. Shared code belongs in services/ (the shared layer). [strangle migration: warning until shared code finishes moving out of src/]
src/ must not import app/ internals directly. Shared code belongs in services/ (the shared layer).
components/ is app-importable shared presentation. It may import services/ (and sibling components/), but must not reach into app/ or src/ internals.

patterns.message: Golden Rule (Design Handovers/auth-service-rebuild.md): no product code imports an auth provider directly. Import via @/services/auth (server), @/services/auth/client (hooks), @/services/auth/ui (prebuilt UI), or @/services/auth/middleware (edge).

Auth barrel rule: import from @/services/auth (server), @/services/auth/client (hooks), @/services/auth/ui (prebuilt UI), @/services/auth/middleware (edge). Blessed exceptions: supabase-admin, admin-user-context, useAuthFlow, log-auth-step. See Design Handovers/auth-service-rebuild.md.
